subject: general
question: Chauri Chaura incident occurred in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1922**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Chauri Chaura incident occurred on **4th February 1922**.
 
• This event took place in the town of **Chauri Chaura** in the Gorakhpur district of the United Provinces (modern-day Uttar Pradesh) in British India.
 
• It was a significant event during the **Indian independence movement**.
 
• A large group of protesters participating in the **Non-Cooperation Movement** clashed with the police, who opened fire.
 
• In retaliation, the demonstrators attacked and set fire to a police station, killing all of its occupants.
 
• The incident led Mahatma Gandhi to call off the Non-Cooperation Movement, showing his commitment to non-violence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Non-Cooperation Movement was launched by Mahatma Gandhi in **1920** as a response to the **Jallianwala Bagh massacre** and other repressive measures by the British government.
 
• The movement aimed to resist British rule in India through non-violent means such as boycotting British goods, institutions, and services.
 
• The Chauri Chaura incident highlighted the potential for violence in mass movements and influenced Gandhi's strategy in the struggle for independence.
